Q: UIScrollView zoomed UIImageView doesn’t bounce on vertical edges during pan A:

You are adding image view inside a UIScrollView and applying zoom functionality on UIScrollView. My suggestion is rather than adding image view inside UIScrollView add image view on main parent view and apply zoom functionality on image view.

Q: Does anyone know how to disable this highlighting in Visual Studio 2022? A:

Updated 2026-02-22:
I did some more testing (updated to Visual Studio Community 2022 v17.14.27) and was able to get rid of this by going to Tools > Options > Environment > Fonts and Colors. Select "Text Editor" in the "Show settings for:" dropdown and select the "Hightlighted Reference" in the "Display items:" list. Set both the Item foreground and background to the same color as your "Plain Text" background color. This gets rid of the highlight and the boxes around the areas. I haven't done other testing to see if this affects other areas though.

Q: Why does JSON not allow encoding infinities and NaN? A:

JSON5 allows standard Javascript notation for positive and negative infinity, NaN, and numerous other things that are valid ECMAScript that were left out of JSON (trailing commas, etc.).

https://json5.org/

This makes JSON a much more useful format.

However, whether using JSON or JSON5: for security reasons, always always parse -- don't evaluate!!
